title: Fill in the Blanks
description: Complete each sentence with the correct word from the box.

questions.text: Arthur spent his entire __________ on a quiet sheep farm in the Scottish highlands.
A kind couple decided to __________ two orphaned siblings and raise them as their own children.
Even as a young boy, Wolfgang was hailed as a musical __________ who could compose concertos at age five.
Despite fracturing his ankle in the qualifiers, the sprinter demonstrated extraordinary __________ to finish the race.
With stunning special effects and a superstar cast, the sci-fi adventure became a summer __________.
The ancient monarch expanded his vast __________ by signing trade agreements with neighboring lands.
The chess grandmaster managed to __________ his fiercest rival after five grueling hours of play.
The experienced chief __________ performed the delicate coronary bypass operation with complete precision.
Emily spent months researching historical archives before writing an acclaimed __________ of the astronomer.
The creative digital __________ drew hundreds of storyboard sketches to bring the cartoon dragon to life.
